note: Penn Station and bus-terminal commuters, evening walkers, rain pedestrians.

lines.text: Excuse me. Sorry. Excuse me. Train.
Evening.
Five-forty to Hicksville. If it runs. It never runs.
Penn Station used to have a roof you could see. Now we live under the Garden.
Gotta make the bus. Last one to Jersey's at midnight.
Two hours a day on a train. I could've learned French.
Train's late. Train's always late. Why do I run?
Thirty-five cents for that subway? They should pay us.
Graffiti on every car. Can't even see out the window.
Rain! No umbrella! No cab! No luck!
Under the awning, under the awning, run!
Summer rain. Smells like hot sidewalk and cigarettes.
Subway platform's a hundred and ten. I measured with my shirt.
Honk all you want! Seventh Avenue doesn't care!
Jesus! I'm walking! I'm walking!
Sorry! Sorry! Train!
Watch it! You made me spill my coffee!
Me too, buddy! Run! The five-forty waits for nobody!
Running for the train? Wrong direction, pal.
You trying to kill somebody? This is a sidewalk!
Trains stopped? If trains stopped I'm sleeping here.
Dark station, dark city. Welcome home.
Missed the last train. Hotel Pennsylvanian? On my salary?
Hot dog cart's open. Cart's always open.
My company's moving to Connecticut. I'm moving to unemployment.
After you. No, after you. Okay, together.
Escalator's broken. Escalator's been broken since sixty-eight.
Fight at the Garden tonight. Whole station smells like beer.
Take half my newspaper. Cover your head.
Thirty years commuting. I know every crack in this floor.
Careful down the stairs. Lights are out on the left.
Morning. Same train, same face. We should form a club.
You found my wallet on the platform. Every dollar. Who does that?
That's him! That's the one who took my briefcase!
Some of us have a train to catch. Out of the doorway.
I saw what you did on Thirty-Fourth. I'm telling the transit cop.
Not again. Not on my train. I'll get off. I'll take the next one.
Take it, take the watch. It's not even gold.
Fine. I've got a train anyway.
Sorry. Sure. Get out of my way.
